evidence.quote: Because Spot Instances are often used to run task nodes, Amazon EMR has default functionality for scheduling YARN jobs so that running jobs do not fail when task nodes running on Spot Instances are terminated. Amazon EMR does this by allowing application master processes to run only on core nodes.
Beginning with Amazon EMR 6.x release series, the YARN node labels feature is disabled by default. The application primary processes can run on both core and task nodes by default.
